retrievalProfile.description: A low-angle black and white photograph of three men against a bright sky, featuring a boxed slab-serif header and a delicate script subtitle.
excludeWhen: modern minimalist sans-serif styles are requested

recipe.visualDefinition: A high-contrast monochrome composition featuring three men in leather and formal attire viewed from a worm's-eye perspective against a blown-out white sky, anchored by a rectangular typographic block at the top.
coreVisualRelationships: Low-angle perspective creating a sense of stature and dominance
High-contrast black and white tonal range with deep shadows
Juxtaposition of heavy slab-serif type with light, flowing script
Triangular arrangement of subjects leading the eye upward
coreInvariants: Worm's-eye camera angle looking up at subjects

compositionAndHierarchy.subjectPositionAndScale: Three subjects occupy the lower two-thirds of the frame, scaled to appear larger than life due to the low angle.
compositionAndHierarchy.visualAnchor: The rectangular typographic box in the upper right quadrant serves as the primary anchor.
compositionAndHierarchy.movementAndEyePath: The eye starts at the bottom left subject, moves across the central figure, up to the rightmost figure, and finally to the text block.
compositionAndHierarchy.negativeSpace: Significant negative space provided by the bright, featureless sky in the upper half.

colorSystem.dominantColorRole: Deep blacks in clothing and shadows
colorSystem.contrastColorRole: Pure white in the sky and text box background
colorSystem.accentColorRole: Mid-tone grays in the leather textures and horizontal graphic bar
colorSystem.saturationAndValueRelationship: Zero saturation; high value contrast between subjects and background.

letterConstructionRules: Primary text uses heavy, blocky slab serifs with circular 'O' motifs
Secondary text uses a thin, continuous-line cursive script
characterSpecificRedesigns: The letter 'O' is enlarged and serves as a central graphic element within the box
typographyAndGraphicLanguage.pairingStrategy: High contrast pairing of a heavy, industrial slab serif with a delicate, personal script.
graphicDevices: Horizontal textured bar behind the main title

candidateDirections.reason: Matches the heavy slab-serif aesthetic of the main title.
Captures the flowing, handwritten quality of the subtitle.

twoStageComposition.backgroundInstruction: Generate a low-angle black and white photograph of three men in leather jackets and hats standing against a bright, overexposed sky.
twoStageComposition.overlayInstruction: Add a rectangular box in the upper right with a bold slab-serif font. Add a thin script subtitle in the upper left.

verificationChecks: Is the camera angle sufficiently low?
Is the main title contained within a rectangular box?
Is the script text legible but delicate?

mustRedesign: Specific facial features of the subjects
postGenerationChecks: Check for high-contrast black and white balance.
Verify the low-angle perspective is maintained.
Ensure the slab-serif and script fonts do not clash.
Confirm the sky is bright and featureless.
recipe.reuseFormula: Low-angle monochrome photography + Boxed slab-serif header + Script subtitle = Soul/R&B aesthetic.
